what: The picture that covered the whole screen (3D scene canvas·photo·video) shrinks on a pinned stage into a round lens bead (diameter 260px, phone 180px) as you scroll — the radius goes from half the screen diagonal + 40px to the bead radius, the picture inside shrinks straight 1 → .34x, and refraction by the sphere normal (ior 1.45), edge light, color fringing and a top-left highlight fill up 0 → 1. During the first 42% of the scroll of stage height minus one screen

options.size-narrow: End diameter (px) for windows under 768px, default size
options.zoom: Inner image scale at the end, default .34
options.span: Share of the front part that folds during stage scroll, default .42
options.--fx-rim: Edge glow color (via style), default var(--kf-accent-soft)
options.--fx-glow: Edge glow color (via style), default var(--kf-accent)
options.[data-fx-part=stage]: Stage (child) that sticks at screen height — if none, the element itself
options.[data-fx-part=source]: Foldable art (child: canvas, img, video) — canvas and video are re-read every frame while visible. Create a WebGL canvas with preserveDrawingBuffer: true

note: The lens that the original made with a three transmission material (MeshPhysicalMaterial transmission) was rebuilt with our WebGL shader. The original shader and model were not used. The source is hidden with visibility:hidden and the bead canvas is laid on top of it.

from.where: index.js .hx (the hero 3D pattern folds into a lens bead beside the mission sentence — the site draws it with the same shader pass behind the three scene)
